It's All in the Numbers
To be sure, the Hurricanes of 2005 have had substantial effects on U.S. This week we take numbers from the Energy Intelligence Agency and analyze how substantial the drop-off has been. children.title: Chart: 2005 vs 2004
children.summary: Prior to the hurricanes, production and inventories of gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel were above year earlier levels, while imports were slightly below 2004 levels. Post-Katrina and Rita, production and inventories of these three crucial products are below year earlier levels, but imports are well above last year's levels.
